On behalf of The President of India, office of the Additional Director General, NACIN, ZC, Shillong invites th e bids under two bid system (Technical Bid and Financial Bid) on Gem (Government e-Marketplace) Portal for hiring of One no. (1) Staff Car (Innova, Fortuner, Endeavour etc.), One no. (1) of A3 Segments Midsized Operational Vehicle. 2. Bids are invited from the established service providers based in Meghalaya State Region (preferably Shill ong), having at least 3 years of experience in such services in Government/PSU/Other Autonomous Bodies for supply of total 2 (two) vehicles on contract basis for a period of one year w.e.f 01.12.2026 to 30.11.2

027 subject to following details given below:- Monthly Ceiling am Sl N Number of Vehi Category Usage ount of the vehicle o cles required (excluding GST) Staff CAR Innova, Fortuner, Ford E Vehicle to be used upt ndeavour, Jeep Compass o 30/31 days of hiring 1 01 Rs. 50,000/- , Tata Hexa, Tata Harrier subject to maximum o , Toyota Hycross, Toyota f 2500 km. in a month Innova Crysta, KIA Caren s, XUV 5OO Operational Vehicle Midsized vehicle Vehicle to be used upt o 25/26 days of hiring 2 (A3 segment) 01 Rs. 50,000/- subject to maximum o Scorpio, XL6, , KIA Seltos f 2000 km. in a month , Creta, Hyundai Verna… . 3. Although the bidders under MSME/Startup India category are exempted from the past experience and tur nover criteria and accordingly proof for the exemption of the same must be attached instead of Experience Certificate and Turnover Certificate. 4. The Bidder shall quote the total lumpsum amount for 12 months of Service including all the taxes. While q uoting the amount the bidder must make sure that the quoted amount is well within the prescribed limits a bove. 5. The Vehicles provided must not be older than 03 years and must be in very good condition. 6. The Hiring of the vehicles shall be one from the date mentioned in the Agreement and may be extended, if services provided are found satisfactory. However, service provider shall have no right for continuity of h is services after completion of 1 year from the date of hiring of vehicles. The hiring shall be extended at th e sole discretion of the Additional Director General, NACIN, ZC, Shillong. 7. The normal working hours will be from 09:30 am to 6:00 pm. However, the vehicles may have to report e arlier or may relieved after 6:00 pm and for this no extra charges will be paid by this office. 8. It will be the sole discretion of the department to use the deployed vehicles for any purpose including on Sunday and Holidays, irrespective of numbers of hours. 9. The vehicle may be used all over Meghalaya and at times outside the state for official duty no additional charges may be borne by the office during this period. 10. In case of the failure of any vehicle deployed during the journey, the Service Provider must arrange for the alternate vehicle immediately. If the Service provider is unable to do so then the proportionate amount of deduction will be done from the monthly payment. 11. The bidders must provide this office with Technical Bid valid GST Registration Certificate, Pan Card, professional Tax Registration Certificate and past experience certificates all merged in a single pdf file as Additional Document in technical bid. Failing to provide any of the aforesaid documents will lead to the rej ection of the bid. 12. The Service provider shall be responsible for the payment of all Government/Local Taxes/Tolls in respect o f the hired vehicles. 13. The vehicles provided under the contract must be properly and comprehensively insured and should carry necessary RC (Reg Certificate), permits/clearances, including pollution clearance (PUC). 14. The bidder must provide the details of the vehicles that it proposes to provide this office along with the te

chnical bid along with the scanned copies of the documents in respect of each vehicle mentioned all merg ed in a single pdf file. 15. The Service provider should ensure that all the provisions relating to Moto Vehicle Act, Insurance provisio ns, Minimum wages Act regarding the payment to the driver and also the provisions of Gratuity to the drive rs are strictly followed by the service provider while providing the vehicles, as all these statutory liabilities will be on account of the service provider/contractor/vehicle provider. 16. In case of any mishap/accident, all the claims arising out from, shall be paid by the vehicle provider. 17. The service provider shall ensure compliance with all labour laws in force. 18. Driver must possess a valid Driving licence to drive the vehicle. He should not smoke or drink (liquor or an y type of intoxication), while on duty. In case of misbehavior of the driver or failure to meet any agreed/ac cepted terms and conditions, a penalty of Rs. 2000/- per instance shall be charged from the contracted ag ency/service provider. 19. Records of the journey/logbook undertaken by the vehicle shall be maintained on daily basis indicating th e time and mileage. 20. The Kilometers shall be calculated on the basis of Zero-based mileage starting from the office. If any vehi cle does not travel upto the limit of prescribed km in any month, then the remaining km will be carried for ward for the next month for the hired vehicle. 21. Billing will be done on monthly basis. At times, the office may not be able to credit the monthly bill becaus e of insufficient fund. However, the service provider should be in a position to pay the salary of the vehicle drivers and the necessary Government taxes, if any. 22. All costs towards, fuel, repairs, maintenance and other taxes etc, if any, shall be borne by the service pro vider. 23. Applicable TDS amount will be deducted from the total bill. 24. The service provider shall ensure that the speedometer and odometer (for measuring distance covered) o f car supplied are properly sealed so that no tampering is done with a view to inflate distance travelled. Th e authorized officer of the Commissionerate would carry out surprise checks of speedometer and odometer of the vehicles. If found defective, would be got fitted from authorized workshop and cost for the same will be recovered from the Service provider by the mode of deduction. 25. The service provider will be liable to pay the wages and allowances to the Driver and the Driver will be on the establishment of the service provider for all practical and legal purposes. This Department would not b e responsible at all to see whether the minimum wages, as per the prevailing Acts and Rules, are being pai d to the Drivers or not, and this would be a matter between the service provider and the Driver(s) and for a ny legal consequences department shall not be a party at all. 26. The liability of this Commissionerate shall be limited to hiring charges only. The service provider and/or dr iver(s) shall not be treated as Government Servant on any ground including that vehicle being used for the Government office duties. 27. The drivers provided along with the vehicles must be nearly dressed and in uniform and should also be in possession of Mobile phone and his mobile number along with the service provider’s mobile number shall b e made available to this office for contracting them regularly. Drivers should be well experienced and well conversant with city and its suburbs and should not have any police case pending or contemplated against them. A declaration to this effect needs to submitted along with the Bid. 28. The Additional Director General, NACIN, ZC, Shillong shall have the right/discretion to terminate the agree ment at any time without giving any notice. If unsatisfactory performance is found during the Contact peri od. 29. The Additional Director General, NACIN, ZC, Shillong shall have right/discretion to reduce/increase numbe r of vehicles provided as per the requirement by giving 1 month notice, effecting the bill amount in the pro portionate way. 30. In case, the Service provider wants to withdraw the vehicle, he has to give two(2) months advance/prior n otice failing which two months charges shall be recovered/forfeited (preceding from the date of stoppage of service by the service provider). 31. The supplier/vehicle driver should report to the Deputy Director/ Additional Director or any officer designa

ted in this office. 32. The bidders may contact the Superintendent/PRO/APRO at the following numbers for any clarifications:- a) Shri Babington Sohtun (PRO)- 8794919507 b) Shri Anmol Bansal (APRO)- 9024652266 33. The bidders are required to upload the signed copy (with company’s seal) of the Terms and conditions whi le submitting the bid. .
